mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, project_id, business_version AS revision_no, source_preparation_id AS source_revision_id, draft_marker, effective_marker, template_id AS project_template_id, template_revision_id AS project_template_revision_id, template_snapshot AS execution_snapshot, completed_by AS frozen_by, completed_at AS frozen_at, status_code, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, 0 AS deleted, dynamic_form_instance_id, entity_value_json FROM sol_preparation WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND preparation_type_code = 'PRE_04_REQUIREMENT_ANALYSIS' ORDER BY business_version, id FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sol_requirement_analysis_revision WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} ORDER BY revision_no, id FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sol_requirement_analysis WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} FOR UPDATE
